name: vutext
why: the .vutext section: VU microprograms, made by the VU assembler; no compiler of ours emits VU micro instructions

name: irx
why: the .irx section: IOP modules (IRX files) embedded in the executable, built for the IOP's R3000 by Sony's IOP toolchain

name: kernel_exec
why: R5900 code InitExecPS2 copies to kernel memory 0x80074000 with a syscall: machine code, not data a program reads

name: kernel_alarm
why: R5900 code InitAlarm copies to kernel memory 0x80076000 with a syscall

name: kernel_ee
why: R5900 code func_0023B290 copies to kernel memory 0x80075000 (0x330 bytes of code, then zeros)
